boiled_potato31: They issued Edmund Potato a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a cracked shaving mirror in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.
A child had enclosed a riddle in a parcel for Edmund Potato. The answer was on the back. He kept the dugout guessing until supper.
Edmund Potato of the Hegemony and Bram Archiegregor of the Concord watched a broken branch near Calvary Farm all morning. Neither side could afford to assume it was only a branch.
bw911k: Norbert Bwk unpacked a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts at S-F18. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.
d4rth_bao: Day 3. The corporal put Gideon Bao beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.
